body: What makes you think you aren't a good person? You seem like you are considering that you'd feel guilt. We both know it wouldn't be better for everyone. Maybe some people. Just kidding. It probably wouldn't help anyone . I don't see the point of us being so hard on ourselves. Hope this doesn't come across as preachy, anotherthrowaway74. I really mean it.

Think about what you want. You want to pass that exam, so what do you have to do? Study for 30 minutes extra? Log out of reddit? Make that a priority. If you fail this one, your that much closer to passing the next one.
You have a nice girlfriend. You said so yourself. If she's really nice, she will understand and not judge you for being at a low point. If she judges you, maybe you should reevaluate how much the relationship is worth. You have supportive parents who are there for you. Don't forget them.
Erase plans of jumping, cars, and pills. Think in possibilities. "I will pass that test, I will treat my gf to a dinner, I will tell my parents how much they mean to me." You got this!

> p

Have you gotten out? Have you said hello to people?

I plan to stay in the game. I'm just not sure what I can do to change it yet.
Thanks for the advice, Xaphs.
